old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a stick of butter in a black frying pan. The butter is positioned horizontally across the center of the frame and remains largely unmelted and static throughout the sequence. The surface of the butter shows minimal changes, with only slight shimmering indicating the onset of melting. The pan itself remains stationary, providing a stable background. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, focusing solely on the butter. The lighting is consistent, highlighting the surface of the butter against the dark surface of the pan.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a stick of butter melting in a black frying pan. The butter is positioned horizontally across the center of the frame, and it gradually begins to soften and spread out as it melts. The surface of the butter starts to shimmer, indicating the onset of melting. As the video progresses, the butter continues to melt, spreading further into the pan and creating a pool of liquid around its edges. The texture of the butter becomes smoother and more fluid, and the color lightens slightly due to the heat. The pan itself remains stationary throughout the sequence, providing a stable background for the transformation of the butter. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, focusing solely on the process of the butter melting. The lighting is consistent, highlighting the glossy sheen of the melting butter against the dark surface of the pan.
caption: The video captures a top-down close view of a dark cooking pan whose left interior glows with a bright brushed-metal sheen. A rectangular, pale-yellow stick of butter rests diagonally in the center, already seated in a pool of melted butter that foams most visibly along its right edge. The solid stick holds essentially the same position, orientation and shape throughout the excerpt, showing no translation or rotation. Around it, the liquid pool and its frothy boundary creep slightly outward, the dark left edge advancing a little farther into the pan. The foam on the right continuously churns and rearranges its bubble pattern, marking ongoing melting and bubbling at the edges rather than a single event. The bright metallic reflection on the pan's wall remains fixed, indicating a stationary viewpoint while the physical changes unfold. No new object enters the frame, and the process neither starts nor finishes here. The butter's slow spread and the restless foam carry the entire motion of the clip.
